title: List library, model type and supplier managers
summary: Gets the integrated library, model type, device sheet and supplier managers from EDP.Utils and lists available libraries, registered model types and supplier sources with 0-based index loops. Documents that the supplier listing throws.
phrasings: open the device sheet folder picker

commands.name: ListLibraryManagers
commands.description: List integrated libraries, model types and supplier sources; ChooseDevice=true first opens the device sheet folder picker (menu only)
commands.params: ChooseDevice=<flag, default off; interactive only> | Max=<n, default 50: entries listed per section>
